question: Can actual public EMC plasma/serum numerical biomarker measurements assess whether longitudinal same-donor changes track disease burden/treatment more informatively than contemporaneous routine markers or imaging?
identity_count_semantics: No newly authenticated EMC donor established; null is unresolved eligibility, not zero actual EMC observations or proof none exist.

new_sources.identity_scope: Printed Table6 five case IDs and diagnoses only
new_sources.status: Five printed measured cases unsuitable: explicit non-EMC; broader >60 cfDNA / 12 WES identity universe remains unlinked and pending
new_sources.assay: Total-cfDNA EIF2C1 measurement distinguished from matched tumor/blood SNV assays and calibration. No total-cfDNA-to-tumor-origin transfer.
new_sources.scope_limit: No biomarker/outcome columns inspected. Table6 diagnosis cannot authenticate all specimens described in Methods. No donor/time/clinical-burden comparator for an EMC stage established.

new_sources.status: Evaluated complete published aggregate histology roster; Other80 individual EMC identity unresolved, no public individual or serial measurement crosswalk
new_sources.conditions: BIP and STING programs, December2020–December2023, adults with advanced tumors; native sample timing and individual disease/imaging/routine-marker conditions not exposed in the recovered aggregate table. Donor overlap with other program publications unknown.

High-fraction aneuploidy/variant estimation and selected clonal-hematopoiesis exclusions are published favorable assay context, not sample-specific EMC detection limits or serial tracking validation.
new_sources.prior_art: Prognostic TF association is already the letter conclusion; baseline prognostic data do not prove longitudinal monitoring. Generic association or roster repair is not a new finding.

new_sources.conditions: 2010–2023 first pleural involvement; 81 histology/cytology diagnoses and 17 clinical-imaging diagnoses. Sampling is first pleural involvement/preoperative context, not a serial burden series.
new_sources.assay: CRP, LDH, albumin and modified Glasgow prognostic score; routine systemic inflammatory/nutritional measures. Source reports CRP mg/dL and albumin g/dL assay context. No individual EMC analyte/imaging pairing inspected or established.

No guessed routes, JS/browser, challenge bypass or unchanged retry. Individual raw data are author-available, not a demonstrated public patient matrix.

new_sources.sarcoma_stage_scope: All eight sarcoma-labelled samples metastatic; no individual sarcoma subtype or EMC authenticity
new_sources.status: Source scope evaluated: cross-sectional pretreatment measurements unsuitable for the original serial claim; generic eight identities and individual data remain unresolved/request-only
new_sources.conditions: All plasma sampled before any oncological therapy. No actual same-donor serial treatment/burden/routine-marker crosswalk. Stage comparisons are not repeated measurements.
new_sources.assay: Circulating eHsp70 sandwich ELISA; blood assay is not evidence of tumor origin, tissue protein localization or therapeutic dependency. No analyte values or ROC outcomes inspected.
new_sources.access: Primary explicitly advertises two supplementary analytical figures, not a patient identity or serial measurement matrix; underlying dataset available only from corresponding author on reasonable request. No request/outreach, figure retrieval or image inspection.
new_sources.prior_art: Stage-dependent burden/ROC association already published; no new monitoring claim. A new public authentic EMC baseline crosswalk would require a distinct prospective question/value challenge before numbers.
new_sources.independent_review_limit: Late source outside peer four-input primary review; owner-only clinical metadata source gate, no independent Hsp70 science validation claimed.

source_repair_contribution: Actual public TF supplement was recovered through its official source href and resolves an aggregate cohort count; this is source repair supporting eligibility, not a new biological finding.
strongest_remaining_alternatives: Total cfDNA or inflammatory proteins may reflect normal-cell injury, hematopoiesis, surgery or therapy rather than tumor burden.
Assay-specific sample input, detection limits and clonal-hematopoiesis controls are required for low/negative tumor signal interpretation.
Baseline/stage correlation or published monitoring case is not a new same-donor incremental monitoring comparison.
Generic histology, overlapping programs, repeated draws and assay timing cannot be silently harmonized.
scope_restrictions: No fusion formation/topology, structural genomics, glycan, FAP or HLA content analyzed. No new gene or biomarker positivity screening.
